Okay so people keep asking me which concert was better, and I keep changing my mind. The first one was in a small place, maybe four hundred people, and the ticket was cheap. The second one was in a stadium and it cost almost twice as much. Twice! Now, the stadium had better lights, a bigger screen, everything. But I was so far from the stage that the band looked like ants. At the small one I was three metres away. Three. So, honestly? The expensive one was amazing, but it was not worth it. The small one wins.

Right, the numbers from this year's school fair. Three hundred people came through the gate, against two hundred last year, so that is our biggest fair so far. The most popular stand was the food stand, which sold everything in one hour. One hour! The art stand did better than last year too. The one thing that was worse: the music. The speakers were fine inside, but outside nobody could hear anything, and that is where most people were. Next year we fix that first.
